Role.UnsetHint: This world has no role yet. Choose Home world for a campaign world that owns real characters, or Hub world for the always-online world where players edit copies.
Role.HomeHint: This world owns the real characters. It sends characters marked as in use to the hub and approves changes players submit there.
Role.HubHint: This world holds copies of characters from home worlds. Players edit them here and submit changes back for approval.

Menu.Name: Character Hub
Menu.Label: Configure
Menu.Hint: Set this world's role (home or hub), the Worker URL, and the API key.
Menu.Title: Character Hub configuration

Settings.WorldRoleHint: Changing the role reloads the world for everyone.
Settings.HomeWorldIdHint: Generated once for this world and never changed. The hub uses it to know which world a character came from.
Settings.HomeWorldIdPending: Generated when you save with the Home world role.
Settings.WorkerUrlHint: The address of your Character Hub Cloudflare Worker, starting with https://.
Settings.ApiKeyHint: The key the Worker gave this world when it was registered. Players in this world can read it, so the Worker only lets it do what players need.
Settings.ApiKeyHintHome: The key the Worker gave this world when it was registered. It is saved in this browser only, so players never see it. Enter it once on each browser you run this world from.

Register.Hint: Register asks the Worker for this world's key and fills it in. Test connection checks the URL and key above without saving them.
Register.Title: Register with the Worker
Register.Explain: Enter the Worker's admin key. It is sent to your Worker once to create this world's key, and is not saved anywhere.
Register.Rotate: If this world was registered before, it gets a new key and the old one stops working, including in other browsers.
Register.Done: {world} is registered. Its key has been saved.

Test.Ok: Connected. The Worker knows this world as {role} world "{worldId}".
Test.Mismatch: Connected, but this key belongs to {role} world "{worldId}", not this world. Register this world to get its own key.

InUse.Stop: In use: stop syncing to hub
InUse.Marker: In use: synced to the hub
InUse.Started: {name} is now in use and was sent to the hub.
InUse.StopConfirm: {name} will be removed from the Worker. The hub will stop receiving updates for this character, and players can no longer submit changes for it.
InUse.Stopped: {name} is no longer synced to the hub.

Sync.NothingToDo: No characters are marked in use.
Sync.NotConfigured: Hub sync is not set up. Open Character Hub settings and register this world.
Sync.NotActiveGM: Another GM is connected and handles syncing for this world.

Status.Pending: {count} in use, {pending} waiting to sync. Last sync {last}.

Error.NoKey: No API key is set for this world.
Error.NoHomeWorldId: This world has no home world ID yet. Save the Home world role first.
Error.Unreachable: Can't reach the Worker. Check the Worker URL and your internet connection.
Error.PlatformLimit: Sync is paused because Cloudflare's free daily limit was reached. It resets at 00:00 UTC.
Error.BadResponse: The Worker gave an unexpected response (HTTP {status}).

Notify.RoleUnset: Character Hub: this world has no role yet. Open Game Settings, then Configure Settings, then Character Hub to choose one.
Notify.BadWorkerUrl: Character Hub: the Worker URL must start with https:// (or http://localhost for testing).
